name: vscode-tailwindcss
description: Intelligent Tailwind CSS tooling for VS Code

works: Class completion in class attributes and JSX className, with a color square for color classes
CSS of a class on hover
Conflict and other diagnostics with quick fixes
Lenses and @source links in v4 CSS files
limits: No color square before a named color class such as bg-red-500 in the text: the extension draws it as a text decoration, which Diode does not render yet. Arbitrary colors such as bg-[#ff0000] get a square

readme:
# Tailwind CSS IntelliSense

Class completion, CSS on hover, conflict diagnostics with quick fixes and class sorting for Tailwind CSS v3 and v4 projects. The language server loads `tailwindcss` from the project and starts only when the workspace has a Tailwind config or a CSS file that imports Tailwind; elsewhere the extension stays quiet.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
